d:
Bentley Motors Chairman & CEO Dr. Frank-Steffen Walliser reveals why a car that costs crores still starts with a pencil and clay.
He explains:
• Why every Bentley still begins as a hand-drawn pencil sketch before any computer touches the design
• How clay models remain the only way engineers can read light and shadow the way a human eye does
• Why Bentley employs 5,000 people on the factory floor when robots could technically do the same job
• What handcrafted stitching achieves that even the most advanced stitching machine cannot replicate
